dataset.name: Pleural and peritoneal mesothelioma biopsy cohort (2023)
dataset.description: Independent NCI mesothelioma cohort with bulk RNA-seq from pleural, peritoneal and tunica-vaginalis biopsies and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Patients with mesothelioma profiled from a study biopsy. Overall survival is measured from that biopsy so the endpoint origin matches the RNA specimen.
dataset.publication_citation: Nair et al. Cell Reports Medicine 2023

metadata.library_method: Bulk tumor RNA sequencing; processed values supplied as TMM-normalized log2 CPM
metadata.curation_note: Eligibility is outcome-independent and requires a published biopsy-survival value, vital status and a matching processed-expression column. One expression profile is published per retained patient. The unmatched NCI0246 expression column is excluded. Date-formatted MARCH gene symbols are repaired by an explicit versioned mapping; symbols duplicated after normalization are excluded rather than merged.

eligibility_rules.column: live/dead (1 = dead, 0 = alive at last contact)

samples.sample_role: Study biopsy used for bulk RNA sequencing

expression.label: Published TMM-normalized log2 CPM
expression.mapping_source: Published Supplementary Table S3 processed-expression genes field with explicit MARCH date repair
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols duplicated in the source or after the explicit Excel-date repair are excluded rather than combined implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The publication states that raw counts were TMM normalized and transformed to log CPM with edgeR. TCGA-TRACE preserves the supplied processed matrix without another transformation.

endpoints.label: Overall survival from biopsy
endpoints.event_column: live/dead (1 = dead, 0 = alive at last contact)
endpoints.time_origin: Study biopsy used for RNA profiling
